hotel.name: St. Regis La Bahia Blanca Resort, Tamuda Bay

verified_facts.text: The resort sits where the Mediterranean Sea meets the Rif Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the meeting point of the sparkling Mediterranean Sea and the majestic Rif Mountains

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 20 minutes from Sania Ramel Airport in Tetouan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 20 minutes from Sania Ramel Airport in Tetouan

verified_facts.text: The resort's design draws on Andalusian and Moroccan heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrating its Andalusian past and Moroccan roots

verified_facts.text: The architecture is reminiscent of traditional riads.
verified_facts.excerpt: Architecturally reminiscent of traditional riads

verified_facts.text: The resort showcases the art of Tetouan multidisciplinary artist Amine Asselman.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcases the fine art of resident Tétouan multidisciplinary artist, Amine Asselman

verified_facts.text: Every suite has a private terrace or balcony with sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every suite features a private terrace or balcony with sparkling sea views

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature handmade furniture, locally sourced linens and curated local artwork.
verified_facts.excerpt: handmade furniture, locally sourced linens, and curated local artwork adorning the walls of each room

verified_facts.text: The Royal Suite is on the fourth floor and has panoramic sea views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Occupying a privileged fourth floor setting, the Royal Suite has panoramic seaviews.

verified_facts.text: Each evening at seven o'clock the head bartender performs a Champagne sabrage ritual at The St. Regis Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each evening is toasted with a seven o'clock signature Champagne Sabrage Ritual, performed by the head bartender.

verified_facts.text: The resort's Bahia Mary cocktail features regional spices, local harissa sauce, rosemary and black pepper.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Bahia Mary has been reinterpreted to feature regional spices, local harissa sauce, rosemary and black pepper

verified_facts.text: The Bahia Mary uses produce from the Chef's Potager.
verified_facts.excerpt: Crafted with locally sourced ingredients, fresh herbs and produce from the Chef’s Potager

verified_facts.text: Baie Blanche Brasserie blends French and Moroccan cooking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Baie Blanche Brasserie blends the culinary artistry of France and Morocco.

verified_facts.text: The resort serves fresh seafood caught daily by local suppliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: serve fresh seafood, caught daily by local suppliers

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea at the resort is inspired by London's drawing rooms and Tetouan's courtyards.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by London’s elegant drawing rooms and the timeless charm of Tetouan’s courtyards

verified_facts.text: The spa's hammam ritual includes a black soap cleanse and a ghassoul clay wrap.
verified_facts.excerpt: followed by an exfoliating Black Soap cleanse and a soothing Ghassoul clay wrap

verified_facts.text: The spa entrance features Moroccan zellige tiles and a cascading fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: the intricate Moroccan Zellige tiles and cascading fountain

verified_facts.text: The resort has a heated outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy Tamuda Bay’s only heated outdoor pool at The St. Regis La Bahia Blanca Resort, Tamuda Bay.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool can be used for swimming even during the winter months.
verified_facts.excerpt: it offers an idyllic setting to unwind and swim, even during the winter months

verified_facts.text: The resort has a private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: the golden sands of our private beach

verified_facts.text: The Moroccan Crea boutique sells caftans, ready-to-wear and beauty essentials designed exclusively for the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: the exclusive Moroccan Crea boutique, featuring refined caftans, prêt-à-porter creations, and beauty essentials designed exclusively for the resort

verified_facts.text: Cooking classes with the culinary team are designed for both adults and children.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join our Culinary Team for a hands-on cooking experience designed for both adults and little chefs.

verified_facts.text: Cooking classes can be booked through the butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: Classes can be booked through your Butler.

verified_facts.text: Guests can explore the ancient ruins at the archaeological site of Tamuda.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore the ancient ruins at the archaeological site of Tamuda

verified_facts.text: The butler can arrange tailored experiences from the sea to the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the sea to the mountains, your St. Regis Butler can arrange a selection of tailored experiences

verified_facts.text: The concierge arranges chauffeured transfers to and from Tetouan Airport, Tangier Airport or Tangier Train Station.
verified_facts.excerpt: chauffeured services to and from Tetouan Airport, Tangier Airport, or Tangier Train Station

verified_facts.text: The resort welcomes well-behaved dogs and cats.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome well-behaved dogs and cats.

verified_facts.text: The butler offers complimentary pressing of up to two garments daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take advantage of complimentary garment pressing, of up to two items daily.

verified_facts.text: A Beach and Pool Day Pass welcomes day visitors.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Beach & Pool Day Pass welcomes day visitors

verified_facts.text: The resort is listed as 2026 Forbes Recommended.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2026 Forbes Recommended
